Subject: Bridge compensation & one-time equity request — tenure retention (Asha Patel)

Hi Laura / Marissa,

Requesting an exception approval for a retention package for one of our long-tenured senior ICs (Asha Patel, EEID: 48219). Asha has been at Redwood for ~6 years and has taken on a de facto tech-lead role across Search infra and LLM batching work. We just lost two peers to external offers and Asha has received an inbound that materially exceeds her current comp.

Proposal for discussion: 
- Immediate spot salary bridge: +12% base (effective next payroll) to align to market mid for tenure and scope
- One-time equity refresh: $40k grant (time-vested over 2 years, cliff at 6 months) as a retention device
- No backpay; non-recurring, intended to bridge to the next formal cycle in 6 months

Rationale (short): sustained high impact, leadership gap risk, market delta ~18% per attached benchmarks. Peer feedback attached and market benchmarks (Q4). This would be a comp-exception (out-of-cycle) and will need Finance & HR sign-off.

Ask: Laura — can you confirm the approval path and any mandatory approvals we need (people ops director, compensation committee)? Marcus — can you flag whether this can be absorbed in current headcount/comp budget or whether we need a reallocation request? Marissa — if you can add a 2–3 line note on outcomes Asha drove in the last 12 months, that will help the packet.

I'm marking this time-sensitive (candidate response expected by EOD Friday 12/11).

Thanks,
Irene
